full_track.tags: K-Pop Funk Rock. Bright, compressed electric guitars play syncopated 16th-note rhythmic scratches and clean-tone riffs. A slap bass guitar follows the kick drum pattern with aggressive thumb pops and finger plucks. The drum kit features a crisp, high-tuned snare and a tight, punchy kick drum. Energetic male tenor vocals utilize a wide dynamic range, shifting between rhythmic chest voice and soaring head voice. Brass stabs from a trumpet and saxophone section punctuate the transitions. The tempo is 124 BPM in the key of E Major.
